authorization: User requested counting the correct move mentioned in an answer despite wording or formatting.
scope: All three current-study deployments and future evaluation answers. Capability checks retain their documented separate diagnostic.
definition: An official solution move mentioned as a standalone UCI, coordinate-with-hyphen, or board-resolvable SAN token anywhere in visible final response text counts as success, even with other moves or nonstandard formatting. Hidden thinking is excluded.
multiple_moves: Any official-move mention counts; alternatives, quotations and negations do not disqualify it. I record all board-legal mentions and flag multiple distinct legal moves. This measures solution-move mention success, not necessarily a single selected move.
termination: A correct move in visible text counts even if output was truncated or has another finish reason. Without a correct visible mention, generation-limit and other termination failures remain failures.
amendment_timing: Post hoc, after inspecting strict results, including completed Gemini test responses. No new held-out evaluation, tuning, fitting or API requests during rescoring.
